judged_text: import_remote passes doc.content into import with no nil check, and import's first statement is `contents << ...`, so any page where readability extracts no article (non-HTML URL, empty body) crashes with NoMethodError on nil. The RetrieveTopic job for that embed_url fails on every attempt, no TopicEmbed row is ever created, and the blog page's iframe shows 'Loading Discussion...' and reloads every 30 seconds forever with no error shown to the reader.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, the code calls `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, ..., doc.content)` with no guard against `doc.content` being `nil` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` immediately does `contents << "\n<hr>..."`, which will raise `NoMethodError` if `contents` is `nil`. The embed flow (`EmbedController#best` enqueues `:retrieve_topic` when no TopicEmbed exists, then renders `loading` which reloads) would keep reloading indefinitely if the job keeps failing and never creates a `TopicEmbed` row.
